subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` use bounded Gateway reattach-and-replay before its existing automatic fresh-session fallback for accepted ambiguous disconnects in both interactive and `--deliver` flows?
rationale: This is not only a duplicate-session repair: it changes the observable disconnect contract, including waiting/output timing and the conditions under which a second execution may occur.

options.title: Adopt reattach-first with preserved fallback
options.body: Approve bounded wait plus cache-only replay before retaining the current isolated automatic fallback when the original outcome remains unknown.

options.title: Keep recook-first
options.body: Retain the existing immediate isolated fallback and limit this PR to already-merged session-containment behavior.

options.title: Split by invocation mode
options.body: Use reattach-first only where delivery semantics make duplicate sends unacceptable, leaving interactive fallback behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Adopt reattach-first with preserved fallback
recommendation.body: Approve bounded wait plus cache-only replay before retaining the current isolated automatic fallback when the original outcome remains unknown.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged change that established the current fallback boundary is the most direct provenance signal for this behavior.
